metadata.description: Reduck CLI skills — the generalist plus lead-gen and product-research verticals.

plugins.name: reduck
plugins.description: Drive the Reduck CLI to perform web tasks (scrape, search, log in, fetch SPA, paginate site-search) as function calls. REQUIRED base for the lead-gen and product-research verticals — install this first.

plugins.name: linkedin-leads
plugins.description: Prospect and qualify leads from LinkedIn activity (post reactors → enriched profiles/companies). Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: facebook-leads
plugins.description: Prospect and qualify leads from Facebook Group/Page activity (members, commenters, top posts). Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: amazon-research
plugins.description: Amazon US product research: search/price, full listing + reviews, category watch. Needs the reduck base plugin.

plugins.name: use-case-skills
plugins.description: Convenience bundle — every vertical (linkedin-leads, facebook-leads, amazon-research). Needs the reduck base plugin. (Also the "Use Case Skills" group in the skills CLI picker.)

plugins.name: required
plugins.description: The reduck base skill on its own — install this first. (Also the "Required" group in the skills CLI picker.)
